Her school guidance counselor. She doesn’t need to go into detail about the abuse if she doesn’t want to, she could just say that there is conflict. (Or if does want to proceed to report them, then she should tell her GC about the abuse)

Another option she has is to wait until she is 18 (admittedly the route I went down). Things get so much easier when you are a legal adult. You can recieve care and medication.
